notes.title: Forest Update
notes.content:
three more levels

added a new boss

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/d5a38978d3d70e355dca443c4ceac6286a7ce3d1.png"]

four more songs (also on my Youtube channel - DragonWind99)

some walls can punch you now

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/f8481cd92d4438e79fbbf884611f44d907226aa1.png"]

"heal" and "damage" animations added to player's healthbar

added mushrooms

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/4d7c6cd85febbc4eb300755becbc88fd5a6c1936.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/aecf1bbbc27a67df627699dd8eefb626a221d129.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/3668189a0b7bab81d64d5a33189245515ed27562.png"]

Spronkus can now be found

knives added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/ad48ccfa357ba460dfddc8550e0c850f135e88f5.png"]

stab_down animation no longer easily interrupted by standing on something for a nanosecond

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247037/dfcdccc2d417c2f8311678f9fc13fc560ce44c77.png"]

hitting "Last Flag" button makes a sound (finally)

updated scoring system
